_description: IT freelancer / Freiberufler document archive. Covers invoicing, clients, tax, and personal mixed use.
_source: German Steuerberater practice + EÜR structure + freelance best practices (2026)

categories.name: Clients
categories.description: Client-specific documents: contracts, SOWs, proposals, timesheets, deliverables, correspondence, NDAs

categories.name: Invoices
categories.description: Outgoing invoices (Rechnungen), credit notes (Gutschriften), invoice drafts, Odoo exports, e-Factura

categories.name: Expenses
categories.description: Business expenses: vendor bills, receipts, Bewirtungsaufwendungen, Reisekosten, office supplies, software licenses, hardware purchases

children.name: Travel
children.description: Reisekosten: flight tickets, hotel receipts, train tickets, taxi, mileage, Verpflegungspauschale, per diem

children.name: Office
children.description: Office expenses: rent, coworking, internet, phone, furniture, Arbeitszimmer

children.name: Equipment
children.description: Hardware, software, subscriptions, cloud services, domain names, hosting

children.name: Meals
children.description: Business meals, Bewirtungsbelege, restaurant receipts with business purpose noted

categories.name: Tax
categories.description: Tax documents: Steuererklärung, EÜR, Umsatzsteuervoranmeldung, Einkommensteuer, Gewerbesteuer, Steuerbescheid, Finanzamt letters

children.name: Annual_Returns
children.description: Annual tax returns, EÜR, Anlage S, Anlage N, Steuererklärung, SteuerGo exports

children.name: VAT
children.description: Umsatzsteuervoranmeldung UStVA, Zusammenfassende Meldung ZM, reverse charge, e-Factura

categories.name: Banking
categories.description: Bank statements, payment confirmations, SEPA transfers, PayPal, Wise, foreign currency transactions

categories.name: Insurance
categories.description: Professional liability (Berufshaftpflicht), health (Krankenversicherung), disability (BU), pension (Rentenversicherung), policies and claims

categories.name: Legal
categories.description: Business registration, Gewerbeschein, Finanzamt Fragebogen, trade license, DSGVO, terms of service, general contracts not client-specific

categories.name: Certifications
categories.description: Professional certifications, training certificates, conference badges, continuing education, ISO, AWS, RedHat, vendor certs

categories.name: Personal
categories.description: Personal documents mixed with business: ID, passport, health, family, property, non-business correspondence

children.name: Identity
children.description: Passport, Personalausweis, driver's license, birth certificate, Meldebescheinigung

children.name: Health
children.description: Medical records, prescriptions, Krankenkasse, dental, lab results

children.name: Property
children.description: Mietvertrag, Nebenkostenabrechnung, Betriebskosten, home insurance, utilities

categories.name: Archives
categories.description: Compressed archives and backups: zip, tar, rar, 7z, dmg, database dumps
